map.按最小二乘拟合线性趋势 y = a + b·x（x 为期次序号），斜率 b 表示: Fit a linear trend y = a + b·x by least squares (x is the period index); the slope b gives the average change per period.
map.下期预测值 = a + b·(n+1)；拟合优度 R² 越接近 1，说明线性趋势: Next-period forecast = a + b·(n+1); the closer the goodness-of-fit R² is to 1, the clearer the linear trend.
map.复合增长率 CAGR =（末期值 ÷ 首期值）^(1/(n−1)) − 1，与移: CAGR = (ending value ÷ beginning value)^(1/(n−1)) − 1, used alongside the moving average for cross-checking the trend.

map.最小二乘：b = (n·Σxy − Σx·Σy) ÷ (n·Σx² − (Σx): Least squares: b = (n·Σxy − Σx·Σy) ÷ (n·Σx² − (Σx)²), a = (Σy − b·Σx) ÷ n; next-period forecast = a + b·(n+1); R² = 1 − SSres ÷ SStot.

map.R² 低说明什么？: What does a low R² mean?
map.说明数据波动大或存在季节性、非线性因素，线性外推不可靠，应改用季节调整或分情景测: It means the data is volatile or has seasonal or non-linear factors, so linear extrapolation is unreliable; switch to seasonal adjustment or scenario-based estimates.

map.仅作参考。外推假设既有趋势延续，实际决策需结合预算安排、市场环境以及可能的政策与: For reference only. Extrapolation assumes the existing trend continues; real decisions must also weigh budget plans, market conditions and possible policy and seasonal effects.
